cases.spec_ref: `lat pack <input> out.zst` — the zstd transport envelope (laterite-transport leaf, on by default via the `transport` feature). zstd is deterministic for a fixed input + level (the AGS4 sweet-spot default, 9), so the packed bytes are identical across launchers; this pins their SHA-256 + size equal on all three. A launcher packing at a different level or wrapping the payload differently would split the hash (laterite-dev#555 part 2).
